summary: Spec fidelity: two leniencies in rows that decide a MUST. L2.destructive-half (safety.rs:313-325) accepts the code of any requires, forbids, atLeastOne or exactlyOne constraint of the command, where checker.md says 'the code of the requires rule that states the relation' (10.8.1): a code declared for an unrelated rule passes. L2.destructive-stale (safety.rs:300) tests next[0] for the word '--plan-digest=' by equality, which no argv word equals, so a next[0] that still carries '--plan-digest=<digest>' passes as the preview. Blast radius: a stale or half-given commit answered with the wrong rule's code, or a PLAN_STALE whose next repeats the commit, is accepted; atip.checkl2safety.04 seeds the accepted-digest and accepted-half cases only.
